messages:
laura: Heads-up: small-window KV rehydrate job failing on fencepost keys during EU hourly backfill. Seeing ~10% failure rate on slices 2026-03-20T12:00..12:05 :warning:
omar: logs?
laura: pasted logs:
```
2026-03-20T12:03:42Z error rehydrate: shard=eu-west-1 slice=20260320-12:03 fencepost_key missing for tenant=acme-corp err=kv_not_found
2026-03-20T12:03:43Z warn replayer: attempt=3 tenant=acme-corp err=panic: index out of range
```
raj: could be a race between slice boundary trimming and dedupe window. Are we truncating keys at minute boundaries or using the full event timestamp?
kevin: On routing side these rehydrates are currently on priority lane `normal-recompute`. Suggest switching to `rehydrate-low` which has longer lease and relaxed preempt behavior. That should reduce partial KV warmups causing misses.
sophia: console flag exists but the UX doesn't expose it. We can add a checkbox "Hold fencepost keys (hold_fence)" but it requires an API change in the reprocess controller -> `hold_fence=true`.
laura: is there a quick mitigation we can run now?
omar: short-term mitigation: extend dedupe window for EU from 2m -> 6m and route current batch to `rehydrate-low`. Quick command we can run: `scripts/replay_ctl set-dedupe --region eu-west-1 --window 6m` and `scripts/replay_ctl set-route --lane rehydrate-low --selector "slice=20260320-12:*"`
kevin: ops-bot: please dry-run routing change first.
ops-bot: Dry run: 42 jobs would move to rehydrate-low. No conflicts detected. :robot_face:
laura: applying dedupe window increase for the in-flight batch now. Monitoring logs... :eyes:
laura: (10m later) failures dropped to ~0.8%. Looks promising.
sophia: I'll open a small PR for API + console toggle and wire it to `hold_fence`. Mock UI is in the branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/replay-ui/pull/1234
raj: follow-up: add a fencepost-miss metric (counter and percent) and an alert at >1% over 5m.
kevin: noted. I'll update runbook with routing fallback and tag on-call for the canary at 03:00 UTC.
laura: action items: (1) PR for API+UI (sophia), (2) metric+alert (raj), (3) runbook + schedule canary (kevin). Re-run small canary with `hold_fence=true` tomorrow 03:00 UTC. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
